title: NotebookLM Is Now Gemini Notebook With Its Own Cloud Computer
description:
NotebookLM isnt just an AI notebook anymore 🔥 Google gave every notebook its own cloud computer that writes and runs code to analyze your data. Its now called Gemini Notebook, 30M users already on board. New version wins 65% of tests, and web search got 78% more accurate ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
transcript: If you haven't used Notebook LM yet, you're seriously missing out. It used to be just an AI notebook, but now Google's given every notebook its own personal computer that writes and runs code on its own. Notebook LM is now called Gemini notebook. 30 million users and 600,000 organizations are already on board. The big deal, a cloud computer right inside your document. It writes code and runs it to analyze your data without ever leaving the notebook. The new version beats the old one in 65% of tests and web search accuracy jumped by 78%. But here's the telling part, competitors have already copied the audio podcast from your sources feature. Now, under the Gemini name, it's baking right into search. Sources, analysis, and search all in one window. Follow me to stay on top of everything AI.
